saw_lines: Team kit gets bought by one organiser for a whole squad, who checks the price and delivery before anyone signs off.
So the sale is decided in the first line, where an organiser weighs delivery and a discount before clicking.
Your site shows 3,958 reviews, yet none of your 30 ads use that number. Put it on the creative and open two ads with a review quote.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 24 Nov 2026
points: Your site shows 3,958 reviews at 4/5, yet 0 of 30 ads carry a proof number, so cold buyers lack a reason to trust you. Put the review count on the creative and open two ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers 15% off every product, yet 0 of 21 copy ads mention any offer, so new buyers have no reason to act. Put the 15% offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

Your site answers how orders ship and lists free delivery, yet 0 of 30 ads mention shipping or delivery. Buyers ordering for a squad want that answer before they click. Answer it in the first line of ads for new buyers.

Your 21 copy ads open 13 different ways, and the biggest story leads 5. That spreads the test thin, so no angle gets enough runs to show what works. Pick the two strongest stories and build the next batch from them.

ads_1: Team kit creative led by the 15% offer, review count and delivery promise
